scripts.build: npm --prefix .. run build:demo && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build
scripts.test: vitest run tests/unit && npm run build && vitest run tests/build
scripts.e2e: SITE_NO_BEACON=1 npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 playwright test
scripts.e2e:browsers: SITE_NO_BEACON=1 npm run build && E2E_BROWSERS=1 PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 playwright test --project=webkit
scripts.e2e:firefox: SITE_NO_BEACON=1 npm run build && E2E_BROWSERS=1 PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 playwright test --project=firefox
scripts.shots:demo: SITE_NO_BEACON=1 npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 playwright test --config playwright.manual.config.ts
scripts.deploy: npm test && account="${CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID:-$(security find-generic-password -s atelier-cloudflare-account -w)}" && CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID="$account" CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN="${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN:-$(security find-generic-password -s atelier-cloudflare-mcp -w)}" WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name useatelier --branch main --commit-dirty=true
